messages:
Leah (Infra): Thanks for the great all-hands — opening this thread for follow-ups on region sequencing, procurement timing, and autoscaler fallback behavior. Drop questions and I'll answer throughout the day.

Sam (Eng): Quick one: will we prioritize new Dedicated leases in EMEA over spinning up temporary US capacity for EMEA traffic? Customers asked about locality.

Leah (Infra): Prioritization rule is: committed Dedicated customers in-region > reserved buffer > cross-region burst. For short-term spikes we'll prefer local reserved buffer; only if that's exhausted we'll route to US-east with user-consent tagging.

Nora (Product): How are we surfacing that routing decision to customers? Need to update docs and show in Console.

Leah (Infra): Console will show a per-route "routing preference" flag and a note when cross-region bursting happens. Nora, would you like a small changelog blurb and a KB how-to?

Nora (Product): Yes please. Also, can we provide expected latency delta numbers for cross-region bursts? Engineering wants a baseline.

Kai (Runtime): Baselines: local H100 p50 ~12ms token, p99 ~40ms; cross-region (EU->US) adds ~60-100ms depending on cloud path, so p99 can be 160-200ms. We'll put the numbers in the model catalog per-region.

Sam (Eng): Oof, that's larger than folks expect. Any mitigations?

Kai (Runtime): Two mitigations: 1) keep a small warm buffer in-region (prefix caching) for chat flows; 2) opportunistic KV sync to reduce cold-starts. Both are config toggles per-route.

procure-bot: Purchase order created for EMEA GPU buffer: PO-8742, expected delivery window 2080170000 - 2080240000.

Leah (Infra): Procurement update: vendor confirmed staggered H100 shipments; initial quota will be mixed A100/H100. We'll prioritize putting H100s on latency-sensitive pools.

Nora (Product): Any impact to customers on Dedicated beta? Those customers were told H100 availability in Q3.

Leah (Infra): We'll meet that expectation for Dedicated beta customers — H100 rollout prioritized for beta pools; general availability follows procurement arrival.

Sam (Eng): Autoscaler question: is the new fallback policy 'latency-aware' by default? I remember a config flag.

Kai (Runtime): Yes, default is latency-aware. fallback_policy: "latency-first" (tries local buffer -> regional buffer -> cross-region only if p99 predicted < threshold). Threshold defaults to 180ms but can be set per-team.

Nora (Product): Action item: add "predicted p99" to the route UI and an opt-out checkbox for cross-region bursting. I'll own this.

Leah (Infra): Thanks — I'll add the procurement ETA to the shared infra doc and ping support to prep KB.

procure-bot: Reminder: PO-8742 requires confirmation of rack space by 2080090000.

Sam (Eng): Who's on point to validate perf numbers once H100s land? We should run standard benchmarks and post results.

Kai (Runtime): I'll run the benchmark suite (latency + throughput + model-delta) and publish to the model catalog. Tentative run: 2080270000.

Leah (Infra): Great. If no other Qs I'll close this thread later today. Feel free to DM for sensitive customer specifics. :wave:
